verdict.rationale: Orrick's Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation Group page explicitly states it addresses 'global compliance requirements and reduce cyber risk' and that partners are recognized for 'incident response,' directly evidencing breach/incident response work; Privacy-in-a-Box also frames data risk/compliance. However, no page explicitly details regulator-facing breach notification work or incident response process specifics. Missing for 10: explicit regulator-facing breach notification examples, detailed incident-response service description, and independent corroboration of this specific practice.
